{{Quote|Spacers think that ships and fuel just pop into the galaxy through a black hole or something. Slip the blockades, tease the Imperials, run the Kessel and Byss and Twin Stars; it's all fun and glamor for those starry-eyed flyboys. But the fact is, it's guys like me that cut through all the rules and regulations so they can zip around the cosmos like kids on a hovertrike. Sometimes I got to remind those hotshots who runs the regulator in this business.|Chaster Fel Gaargaaz|<ref name="SWG:GSSNaLT">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Got Some Spacers Need a Lesson Taught}} on Corellia</ref>}}
'''Chaster Fel Gaargaaz''' was a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] magnate who lived on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Fel Gaargaaz was getting more and more upset about [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]]. The magnate was disgusted that they felt free to do their businesses without respecting any rules while honest business people like himself had to.<ref name="SWG:GSSNaLT" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Chaster Fel Gaargaaz finally hired a strike team to attack a band of spacers on Corellia and teach them a lesson.<ref name="SWG:GSSNaLT" />

==Behind the scenes==
Chaster Fel Gaargaaz was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:GSSNaLT" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Chaster Fel Gaargaaz was mentioned in a mission called "Got Some Spacers Need a Lesson Taught" available on [[mission terminal]]s on Corellia.<ref name="SWG:GSSNaLT" />
